defects.description: Direct dataclass construction could set trading_authority=true, bypassing the create() factory invariant.
defects.resolution: Added fail-closed __post_init__ validation to both launch-evidence and owner-confirmation records; direct construction with authority now rejects.

observations.description: Evidence parsing: exact schema (22 keys), exact key set, JSON object, trading_authority=false. Extra/missing fields reject. Wrong schema rejects.
Evidence identity = SHA-256 of canonical body excluding evidence_id. Wrong identity rejects. Identity is lowercase SHA-256.
Source hashes: nonempty, unique, lowercase SHA-256. Empty/duplicate/malformed/uppercase all reject.
All SHA-256 identifiers (repository_checkpoint, watchdog_report_id, recovery/stale drill report_ids) validated.
UTC timestamps mandatory. Naive and non-UTC offset reject.
Counts are integers, reject booleans, required counts nonnegative. Clock skew must be integer (rejects bool).
Evidence immutable (frozen dataclass). Source hashes stored as tuple.
Owner confirmation and launch evidence are immutable and reject trading_authority=true through every construction path.
Confirmation expires <= 5 minutes. confirmed_at < expires_at. Over 5 minutes rejects. Not-current rejects. Expiry is exclusive (as_of < expires_at).
Confirmation checkpoint must match both evidence and policy. Risk limits (session, commands, notional, gross) must match policy exactly. Smaller/larger/different limits reject.
Missing owner supervision/stop control → ineligible gate decision (2 reasons). Owner confirmation cannot grant trading authority.
Adapter preserves all evidence fields exactly when constructing launch facts. Gate remains advisory-only, BTC-only, unable to submit.
No os/sys/subprocess/git/socket/network/credential/live/task-mutation imports. Only dataclass, datetime, decimal, hashlib, json, pathlib, launch_gate used.
No owner-approval/profitability/OOS/deployment/unattended claim in module. Docstring: 'Strict evidence and owner-confirmation adapter'.
